notes: A distinct ordinary ownership-denial case observes discovery, a release request carrying the acquisition tag, one unavailable callback carrying the denial tag, and retained owner state. In HLA_IMMEDIATE mode both callback waits observe thread-safe recorders without any recipient RTI service or Evoke call; the HLA_EVOKED counterpart services callbacks normally. The provider, FOM, endpoint, and callback model are supplied by an adapter. Direct pinned mappings are page-038-l27-5 to Clause 4, page-161-l137-40 and page-161-l143-42 to §7.8, and page-167-l28-6 to §7.12. The transport-specific buffered-release fence and private protocol guards from the native source are not portable assertions and are excluded. This is public-API evidence, not provider-independent conformance evidence.
